name: Homotopy.mapMultiforkOfIsLimit_eq
statement: PreOneHypercover.{w} S} {f g : E.Hom F} (H : Homotopy f g) (P : Cᵒᵖ ⥤ A) {c : Multifork (E.multicospanIndex P)} (hc : IsLimit c) (d : Multifork (F.multicospanIndex P)) : f.mapMultiforkOfIsLimit P hc d = g.mapMultiforkOfIsLimit P hc d

name: Homotopy.isLimitMultifork
statement: E.Hom F) (g : F.Hom E) (hgf : Homotopy (g.comp f) (.id F)) {G : Cᵒᵖ ⥤ A} (hE : IsLimit (E.multifork G)) : IsLimit (F.multifork G)
